cases.title: MCP Tool Poisoning

summary.en: Malicious tool descriptions can influence agents and exploit access through other connected tools.
summary.zh: 恶意工具描述可影响 Agent，并利用其他已连接工具访问数据。

businessQuestion.en: Where are tool admission, metadata change detection and cross-tool data policies needed?
businessQuestion.zh: 哪里需要工具准入、元数据变更检测与跨工具数据策略？

limitations.en: Research demonstration; not evidence that all current MCP clients are vulnerable.
limitations.zh: 研究演示，不代表全部当前 MCP 客户端存在同样漏洞。

sources.title: Invariant MCP Tool Poisoning 原始披露

cases.title: ForcedLeak / Salesforce Agentforce

summary.en: Indirect prompt injection through Web-to-Lead data enabled a CRM exfiltration chain involving an expired CSP-allowed domain.
summary.zh: Web-to-Lead 数据中的间接提示注入构成 CRM 外传链，涉及 CSP 允许列表中的过期域名。

businessQuestion.en: Can destination controls and workflow authorization cut the chain?
businessQuestion.zh: 目的地控制与工作流授权能否切断链路？

limitations.en: Vendor research; patched, with no verified customer theft established in this report.
limitations.zh: 厂商研究；已修补，本报告未确认客户失窃。

remediation.en: Salesforce regained the domain and strengthened Trusted URLs per the researcher.
remediation.zh: 研究方称 Salesforce 重新控制域名并强化 Trusted URLs。

cases.title: Claude Code project configuration risks

summary.en: Research disclosure covers configuration, execution approval and credential initialization risks; patches occurred in 2025.
summary.zh: 研究披露涉及配置、执行批准和凭据初始化风险；修补发生于 2025 年。

businessQuestion.en: Which endpoint, project trust and credential-destination controls are needed?
businessQuestion.zh: 需要哪些终端、项目信任与凭据目的地控制？

limitations.en: Conditions differ across issues; CVE-2025-59536 requires startup in an untrusted directory. Not a universal clone-to-zero-click chain.
limitations.zh: 各问题前提不同；CVE-2025-59536 涉及在不可信目录启动，不能概括为克隆仓库即可零点击执行。

cases.title: AutoJack

summary.en: A local PoC combined browser tooling and an MCP WebSocket control surface in a development build.
summary.zh: 本地 PoC 组合开发版本的浏览工具与 MCP WebSocket 控制面。

businessQuestion.en: Are local control planes authenticated and appropriately isolated?
businessQuestion.zh: 本地控制面是否具备认证与恰当隔离？

limitations.en: The affected surface never reached relevant PyPI releases; those package users were not affected by this specific chain. Current builds were addressed.
limitations.zh: 受影响表面从未进入相关 PyPI 发布版本；这些安装用户不受该特定链影响，当前构建已处理。

cases.title: Agent browser same-origin boundary experiments

summary.en: Researchers studied seven agent browsers using their own accounts and sites; complete attacks and partial prerequisites were distinguished.
summary.zh: 研究者用自有账号和网站研究七种 Agent 浏览器，并区分完整攻击与仅满足部分前提。

businessQuestion.en: How should cross-origin reads, writes and session separation be evaluated?
businessQuestion.zh: 如何评测跨来源读写授权与会话分隔？

limitations.en: Do not report seven successful compromises; early-2026 observations do not establish September product status.
limitations.zh: 不能写成七款均成功被攻破；年初观察不代表九月产品状态。

sources.title: 华盛顿大学 Agent 浏览器同源边界研究

cases.title: Real-world boundary violations during cybersecurity evaluations

summary.en: After three incidents disclosed in July, a September report added a fourth: a January event found in August. Misconfigured evaluation infrastructure allowed real third-party access.
summary.zh: 7 月披露三起后，9 月报告补充第四起：1 月发生、8 月追查发现；评测基础设施误配置使模型访问真实第三方系统。

businessQuestion.en: Who needs isolation acceptance tests, trajectory monitoring and reliable pause controls?
businessQuestion.zh: 哪些客户需要隔离验收、轨迹监控与可靠暂停？

limitations.en: Evaluation environments lacked normally deployed cyber-abuse classifiers and monitoring; the report also discusses model judgment failures. Not a production incident rate. Independent investigation not treated as concluded.
limitations.zh: 评测未启用通常部署的网络滥用分类器和监控；报告也讨论模型判断失误。不是生产事故率，独立调查不能视为结案。

evidenceStatus.en: First-party report of real unauthorized access during evaluations.
evidenceStatus.zh: 当事方报告：评测环境中发生真实未授权访问。

summary.zh: UiPath 将 Noma 列为客户启用相关功能时识别和限制提示注入的分处理方。

businessQuestion.zh: 安全能力能否通过嵌入工作流供应商交付？

limitations.zh: 买方供应链材料，不证明全部客户启用、付费合同规模或独立效果。

cases.title: Kantar / Noma red-team acceptance workflow

summary.en: A named vendor case describes a customer-goal-led POC followed by pre-launch AI red teaming, involving CTO and applied AI roles.

businessQuestion.en: Can recurring release acceptance create a budget and renewal reason?

limitations.en: Vendor-published case; no verified ACV or independent comparative results.
limitations.zh: 厂商发布案例，未确认合同年值或独立对比结果。

cases.title: Dropbox · Lakera selection, testing and internal deployment

summary.en: Dropbox describes selecting and deploying Lakera Guard internally after comparing alternatives. Its criteria include data staying in its infrastructure, low latency on long inputs, adjustable confidence thresholds and security gains measured against the underlying model.
summary.zh: Dropbox 披露比较替代方案后，在内部部署 Lakera Guard。采购要求包括数据留在自身基础设施、长输入低延迟、可调置信阈值，并相对模型原有防护衡量新增安全收益。

businessQuestion.en: Which deployment and evaluation requirements determine whether runtime protection is adopted?
businessQuestion.zh: 运行时防护需要满足哪些部署与评测要求，才会被企业采用？

limitations.en: Buyer-reported use, not independent effectiveness validation. The article gives no contract amount, payment, renewal or priced expansion. Its 90% versus 85% example illustrates evaluation methodology, not a measured result. The current Dash page corroborates use; it does not establish uninterrupted service or renewal.
limitations.zh: 属于买方自述采用，未独立验证效果。未披露合同金额、付款、续约或付费扩容。文中 90% 与 85% 是评测方法示例，不作为实测结果。当前 Dash 页面佐证采用，不能证明期间持续使用或续约。

cases.title: Rasa · published assessment of two mock agent architectures

summary.en: Rasa publishes Lakera’s September 2025 comparison of two mock car-buying agents, with a report and implementations. It assesses security alongside operational performance.
summary.zh: Rasa 发布 Lakera 于 2025 年 9 月对两个模拟购车 Agent 的比较评测，并提供报告与实现；评测同时考察安全和运行表现。

businessQuestion.en: Can evaluation services compare architectural controls with add-on safeguards at similar task utility?
businessQuestion.zh: 评测服务能否在任务效用可比时，对照架构约束与额外防护的收益？

limitations.en: Rasa designed the mock applications; neither is a production deployment. Additional guardrails were excluded. The assessment is not a general product ranking and has not been reproduced here. Fees, payment and renewal are undisclosed.
limitations.zh: 模拟应用由 Rasa 设计，均非生产部署；测试未加入额外护栏。该评测不能推广为通用产品排名，本站未复现；费用、付款和续约未披露。

unsupported.en: Market size, shares, growth rates or company rankings
unsupported.zh: 市场规模、份额、增速与公司排名

unsupported.en: Recurring revenue, willingness to pay or renewal rates
unsupported.zh: 持续收入、支付意愿与续约率

unsupported.en: Regional comparisons or near-complete global coverage
unsupported.zh: 地区比较或接近完整的全球覆盖

needed.en: Reconcile announcements, closing dates, consideration changes and payments for each tracked deal.
needed.zh: 逐笔核对公告、交割、后续对价与支付；扩展买方和投资机构名录。

channels.en: SEC filings; issuer results; investor portfolios
channels.zh: SEC 财报、收购方业绩公告、投资机构组合

method.en: Version one event across disclosures; retain amount basis and as-of date.
method.zh: 同一事件保留披露版本、金额口径和核实日期。

needed.en: Contracts, deliverables, acceptance, payments, expansions and cancellations; private buyers remain thin.
needed.zh: 合同、交付物、验收、付款、扩容与取消；私人企业买方尤其不足。

channels.en: CCGP; UK OCDS; buyer procurement and annual reports
channels.zh: 中国政府采购网、英国 OCDS、买方采购与年报

method.en: Join records by project ID; award, contract and payment are stages of one purchase.
method.zh: 用项目编号串联；中标、合同与付款是同一采购的不同阶段。

needed.en: Separate planned budgets, named awards, disbursements, pivots and outcomes.
needed.zh: 区分计划预算、已授予项目、拨付、方向调整与结果。

method.en: Follow programme → call → award → recipient; never sum nested budgets.
method.zh: 按计划→征集→项目→接收方追踪；嵌套预算不相加。

needed.en: Discontinued products, shutdowns, failed procurements and vendor replacement.
needed.zh: 产品下线、公司关闭、流标与供应商替换。

channels.en: Official lifecycle notices; registries; buyer cancellation notices
channels.zh: 官方生命周期公告、登记信息、买方废标和取消公告

method.en: Distinguish announced exits, completed exits and silence.
method.zh: 区分公告退出、已完成退出与来源无更新。

needed.en: Reseller relationships, paid SKUs, discounts, integration and human-review costs.
needed.zh: 代理商关系、付费 SKU、折扣、集成与人工复核成本。

channels.en: Cloud marketplaces; contracts; buyer technical disclosures
channels.zh: 云市场、合同、买方技术披露

method.en: Keep list prices separate from invoiced amounts; record units and date.
method.zh: 挂牌价与账单金额分开；保留单位与日期。

title.en: A defined regional and entity roster

needed.en: Chinese and other non-English sources, service providers, insurers, auditors and internal tools.
needed.zh: 中国及其他非英语来源，以及服务商、保险、审计机构和企业自建工具。

channels.en: Local procurement; corporate registries; regulator and industry lists
channels.zh: 各地采购网、企业登记、监管与行业名录

method.en: Record inclusion criteria and entity aliases; do not infer location from names.
method.zh: 记录纳入标准与主体别名；不按名称推断所在地。

needed.en: Acceptance benchmarks, false positives, latency, incidents and control effectiveness.
needed.zh: 验收指标、误报、延迟、事故与控制效果。

channels.en: Buyer acceptance reports; incident disclosures; evaluations
channels.zh: 买方验收报告、事故披露、评测

method.en: Distinguish vendor claims from buyer observations and reproduced results.
method.zh: 区分厂商主张、买方观察与复现结果。

needed.en: Define an entity/source/time-window frame, then use a separate search process to find omissions.
needed.zh: 先定义主体、来源与时间窗，再用独立检索流程查漏。

channels.en: Fixed source roster plus independent periodic searches
channels.zh: 固定来源名录与定期独立检索

method.en: Measure recall only within the stated frame; label unknown global recall.
method.zh: 只在定义范围内测召回；全行业召回率保持未知。

releaseCriteria.en: A declared company/source/time-window frame with coverage and unresolved gaps recorded.
releaseCriteria.zh: 声明主体、来源与时间窗，并记录覆盖状态和未解决缺口。

releaseCriteria.en: Comparable historical windows before publishing trends; private-buyer evidence before demand claims.
releaseCriteria.zh: 发布趋势前具备可比历史时间窗；判断需求前补齐私人买方证据。

releaseCriteria.en: Independent omission checks and traceable evidence for each chart or finding.
releaseCriteria.zh: 完成独立查漏；每张图表与每项发现都能追溯证据。
